appearance.title: Theme
appearance.description: Choose a color theme for the interface. The theme is saved locally and applied instantly. Custom themes can be created, edited, and deleted.

themeEditor.nameExists: A theme with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
themeEditor.deleteConfirm: Delete theme "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

changePassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.enabled: MFA is enabled. Enter your password to disable it.
twoFactor.disabled: MFA is disabled. Set up TOTP to secure your account.
twoFactor.setupHint: Scan the QR code or enter the secret in your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose your interface language. Proper nouns stay in English.
language.englishNote: English is the universal business language and the default.

dateTime.title: Date & Time
dateTime.description: Choose how dates and times are displayed. Times are converted from UTC to your selected timezone.

format.tokenHelp: Tokens: yyyy=year, MM=month, dd=day, HH=24h, hh=12h, mm=minute, ss=second, a=AM/PM
format.invalid: Format must be a non-empty string (max 64 chars).
